ticks.note: Pressed: a rising edge, so the chart enters `Firing`, whose entry action switches `pulse` on.
`pulse` stays on, although nothing happens to the button.
`if 3 true` has now counted three ticks after the entry tick: `Firing` is left, its exit action switches `pulse` off. The button is still held, but that does not matter.
A short press of one tick ...
... still gives a pulse of three ticks: the length of the pulse does not depend on the press.
Pressed again while the pulse is running: `Firing` has no transition for the button, so the new press is ignored.
The pulse ends. `Ready` is entered while the button is held, and that is no new rising edge: no new pulse.
